recommendations.action: Implement mandatory customer service training for all front-of-house staff, focusing on empathy, attentiveness, and conflict resolution. Introduce a staff recognition program for excellent service.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significantly improve customer interactions and overall dining experience, reducing a major source of complaints.

recommendations.issue: Poor cleanliness standards (tables, restrooms, general areas).
recommendations.action: Develop and enforce daily/weekly cleaning checklists for all areas, including restrooms and dining surfaces. Assign specific staff for regular spot checks during service hours and conduct monthly deep cleans.
recommendations.expected_impact: Enhance hygiene, improve customer comfort, and elevate the restaurant's perceived quality and professionalism.

recommendations.issue: Unpleasant, outdated, or uncomfortable restaurant ambience.
recommendations.action: Conduct a professional assessment of the dining area's decor, lighting, seating comfort, and noise levels. Prioritize cost-effective updates (e.g., fresh paint, new lighting, comfortable chair cushions) and address any major maintenance issues.
recommendations.expected_impact: Create a more inviting and comfortable dining environment, attracting new customers and improving retention.

recommendations.issue: Broad, unspecified customer dissatisfaction indicating inconsistent service delivery and operational standards.
recommendations.action: Implement a comprehensive 'Guest Experience Audit' covering all customer touchpoints from arrival to departure. Use findings to refine service standards and create a continuous improvement plan across all operational areas.
recommendations.expected_impact: Address systemic inconsistencies, leading to a holistic improvement in customer satisfaction and a reduction in general negative feedback.

recommendations.issue: Customers perceive pricing as too high or not offering good value for money.
recommendations.action: Conduct a detailed menu engineering analysis to assess profitability and perceived value of each dish. Consider introducing value-focused specials, adjusting portion sizes, or slightly modifying ingredient quality to better justify prices.
recommendations.expected_impact: Align pricing with customer expectations, improve perceived value, and potentially optimize menu profitability.

recommendations.issue: Long waiting times for seating, ordering, or receiving food.
recommendations.action: Analyze staffing levels during peak hours and optimize kitchen workflow to reduce bottlenecks. Implement a digital table management system and train staff on efficient order taking and delivery processes.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduce customer wait times, improve operational efficiency, and enhance the overall dining experience.

recommendations.action: Develop and enforce strict standardized recipes and portion controls for all dishes. Implement a daily taste-test and quality check protocol for all dishes before service, involving kitchen management.
recommendations.expected_impact: Ensure consistent high-quality food, meeting customer expectations and strengthening the restaurant's culinary reputation.
